name: H3 AdaLN trajectory precompute (Sol-H3 helper)
plain: Computes every block's large AdaLN projection once for the whole sampling schedule, then swaps those modules for parameter-free lookups, so the big weights need not stay loaded during denoising. An unknown timestep table falls back to the original module. This is an exact cache of a deterministic function, not an approximation.
math:
For each σ in the schedule: rebuild the sorted unique t set the model will use (t_v, t_a, conditioning pins, mask rows).
Table[block][step] = adaln_proj(t_emb(t set)). At run time match t_emb by max-abs error ≤ 5e-4 (16-bit) or 2e-5, else call the original.

props.hook: APPLY_MODEL wrapper; modules replaced in the tree and restored after sampling
props.architectures: Stock H3 with time_embedder; declines curve checkpoints
